data.content:
## Summary

This PR remediates 14 WCAG 2.1 AA issues found by the Arma audit of maison-lumiere.fr (4 page templates covering the full purchase funnel). Each commit maps to one WCAG criterion and every fix was verified by an independent tester agent.

- Score: 38 → 95
- Automated violations: 17 → 0
- Controls unreachable by keyboard: 9 → 0

## Changes by criterion

### WCAG 2.4.7 Focus Visible
- A05: Keyboard focus is invisible on every page

### WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard
- A07: “Ajouter au panier” cannot be reached with the keyboard
- A08: Size selector is mouse-only and has no state
- A09: “Commander” and “Payer” are not keyboard operable

### WCAG 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions
- A10: Checkout fields use placeholders instead of labels

### WCAG 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
- A06: Header icon buttons are announced as emoji
- A15: Quantity and remove buttons have no accessible name

### WCAG 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum)
- A01: Low-contrast secondary text (hero, price notes, footer)

### WCAG 3.3.1 Error Identification
- A11: Form errors are shown only by a red border

### WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content
- A03: Product images have no text alternative

### WCAG 1.3.1 Info and Relationships
- A13: Home page has no h1 and skips heading levels

### WCAG 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context)
- A12: Four identical “En savoir plus” links

### WCAG 2.4.2 Page Titled
- A14: Checkout page title is vague

### WCAG 3.1.1 Language of Page
- A02: Page language not declared

## Needs human review

- **A04** (1.1.1) Product photo alt text says only “image”: Draft alt text applied. Merchandising must confirm colour and material: the agent does not invent product facts.
- **A16** (1.3.1) Third-party card widget not verifiable: Request the provider's accessibility conformance report and add it to the statement. Vendor responsibility.

data.content:
# Accessibility statement · Maison Lumière

Maison Lumière is committed to making maison-lumiere.fr accessible, in line with the European Accessibility Act and the French law transposing it.

## Compliance status

The website is **partially compliant** with EN 301 549 v3.2.1 and WCAG 2.1 level AA, due to the non-compliant content listed below.

## Non-accessible content

- Product photo alt text says only “image” (WCAG 1.1.1). Draft alt text applied. Merchandising must confirm colour and material: the agent does not invent product facts.
- Third-party card widget not verifiable (WCAG 1.3.1). Request the provider's accessibility conformance report and add it to the statement. Vendor responsibility.

## How this statement was prepared

Audit of 4 page templates covering the full purchase funnel on 15 October 2026, combining automated testing (axe-core), keyboard testing and expert review by AI agents, with independent verification of every fix. Testing with disabled users: [TO COMPLETE].

## Feedback and contact

If you cannot access content or a service, contact [TO COMPLETE: accessibility contact email]. We respond within [TO COMPLETE: time frame].

## Enforcement

If you are not satisfied with our response, you can contact the market surveillance authority: [TO COMPLETE: national authority].
